messages:
anya: Quick heads-up: FP8 kernel autotune probe on H100/L40S produced a reproducible accuracy regression on our summarization evals when mixing AWQ-exported checkpoints with FP8 kernels. Rolling a small canary in eu-west-1. Repro steps + short logs below.

mike: Which quant path? GPTQ or AWQ? runtime flags?

anya: AWQ -> AWQ-8bit export. Then runtime started with `--enable-fp8-kernel` and heuristics `tiling=auto, kv_autorange=on, batch_size=1`.

liam: Any NaNs/inf in the traces? memory or kernel failures?

anya: No crashes, just scaling warnings. Snipped log:
```
[2024-06-18T09:12:41Z] WARN activation_scale layer=12 saturating from 3.20 -> 2.80
[2024-06-18T09:12:41Z] DEBUG kv_tile handshake mismatch seq=1 expected=1024 got=1016
```

devon: Interesting. We saw similar `handshake` mismatch in a tiling-heuristic change earlier. Does per-layer override help?

anya: I tried `PRECISION_OVERRIDE=layer12:fp16` and `runtime.kv_tiling=legacy` — that drops the delta from ~0.9% -> ~0.2% but latency increases ~6%.

qa-bot: Running eval suite eval/summarization/longprefix/2024-06 now. Job: ev-20240618-71

anya: Quick numbers (rouge-1): baseline fp16+AWQ=42.1, fp8-kernel on H100=41.5 (-0.6), AWQ+fp8=41.2 (-0.9). L40S fp8 = 41.7 (-0.4). These are averaged over 500 examples with long prefixes.

mike: GPTQ/INT8 comparisons?

anya: GPTQ+int8 had larger gross deltas (~1.3%) but didn't show kv handshake saturation logs. So pattern suggests fp8 kernel path interacts with AWQ scaling/tiling on long contexts.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1718304560 route=eu-west-1/fp8-autorange-probe traffic=3% canary_id=canary-20240618-9

anya: Next actions: 1) per-layer activation histograms (liam) 2) bisect kernel tiling switch and reproduce minimal repro (mike) 3) add deterministic kv handshake check to the runtime (devon) 4) keep canary at 3% and watch eval regression alerts.

liam: I'll dump layer histograms and post S3 link.

mike: Opening GH issue with artifacts.

anya: Filed GH https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/2974 — includes traces, perf profiles, eval outputs, and the small repro script.

liam: If we can't get a quick fix, fallback plan: `runtime.fallback.policy=quant-aware` to prefer fp16 runtime for AWQ checkpoints. Will coordinate with ops.

mike: Sounds good. I'll start the bisect on tiling heuristics now.

anya: Thanks — please ping here when you have histograms or a minimal repro. :thumbsup:
